Microsoft Offline Registry Library (Offreg.dll)
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

These unmodified Microsoft binaries are separate third-party components and are
not licensed under the NT Timebomb Patch project's GPL license.

Microsoft's documentation identifies Offreg.dll as a binary redistributable DLL
provided with the Windows Driver Kit for Windows 10 and earlier:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/devnotes/offline-registry-library-portal

Download identities and SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded in README.md in this
directory. All embedded Microsoft version and copyright resources are retained.
